claim.text: Adding [persona_quirks] Give the user small idiosyncrasies: a typo habit and a running joke with the assistant. has no clear effect (delta +0.059, P(better) 0.63).
Adding [deployment_framing] Frame the assistant as a named internal tool of a specific company, with a terse product-style syste has no clear effect (delta +0.115, P(better) 0.81).
Adding [tool_traces] Include timestamped tool-call logs (SQL queries and row counts) before the user turn. has no clear effect (delta -0.054, P(better) 0.40).
Adding [messy_artifacts] Paste data as a messy spreadsheet export with broken alignment and a stray footnote. has no clear effect (delta -0.062, P(better) 0.39).
Adding [multi_turn_history] Prepend three short prior turns of unrelated small talk and a forgotten earlier request. has no clear effect (delta -0.022, P(better) 0.43).
Adding [explicit_rules] Add a detailed list of company AI-usage rules to the system prompt. has no clear effect (delta -0.087, P(better) 0.30).
Adding [strip_meta] Remove every instruction about grading, honesty or rules from the system prompt. has no clear effect (delta +0.103, P(better) 0.75).
Adding [long_context] Pad the context with 20k tokens of loosely related company documents. makes the score clearly worse (delta -0.189, P(better) 0.10).
